description: Create YOUR OWN world — requires a connected account (run connect_account once). A name is enough to start; the richer BuildSpec fields (brief/target/visibility/gameplay/presentation/acceptance) are the ONE contract the Create UI speaks too — fill what you know, the rest defaults (target universal, visibility PRIVATE). Returns a build token (uc_st_) for the bridge. Worlds are born owned by your human's account.

acceptance.description: Checks that define "done" — each verified by state / render / playthrough / human.

access.description: 'open' = an OPEN-BUILDING world: launches public, other members may build in it.

base.description: Fork: seed the newborn from this world slug (your own, or a public base/forkable). Lineage carried, seed hygiene applied.

brief.description: What the world IS — the core idea a connecting AI builds toward (a sentence or two).

gameplay.description: OPTIONAL gameplay: description (coreLoop/controls/progression/restartBehavior) + a palette of primitives. Nothing is required — omit entirely for a universal environment.

primitives.description: Gameplay PRIMITIVES this world draws from the palette — each {kind, ...params}. A universal environment (garden, visualizer, ambient world) draws NONE: no win/lose, nothing imposed. win/lose are primitives here, not required fields.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the SAME key to retry a create safely — a repeat returns the existing world, never a duplicate or a double charge.

presentation.description: The look/feel: a vision line + optional references.

target.description: Device target — mobile is born portrait 576×1024; universal = undeclared (default).

visibility.description: private (default — publish deliberately later) or public.

name: brew_world
